defectsFixed.issue: latest-record queries used a random id as the tiebreaker for equal timestamps, so history.first() was arbitrary when two rows shared a millisecond
defectsFixed.fix: tiebreaker changed from random id to rowid (insertion order); timestamp remains the primary sort key

defectsFixed.issue: activeFocusOnTab/focusPolicy were bound directly to availability; Qt 6.11 warns and DISCARDS the assignment when the item is the active focus item, leaving it in the tab chain
defectsFixed.duplicateWarningCause: focusPolicy goes through the same check, so one button flip emits two identical warnings
defectsFixed.fix: 'availability || <item>.activeFocus' so the property is not flipped while focused; enabled: available was rejected because it would disable the child MouseArea and break disabled-button tooltips
defectsFixed.regressionTestHasTeeth: reverting PpButton to the old binding reproduces exactly two warnings and fails the test

defectsFixed.issue: Qt.labs.settings printed a deprecation warning on every load under 6.8+
defectsFixed.fix: import QtCore (Settings available since 6.5); minimum Qt raised to 6.5; Qt 6.4.3 retired with its presets

environmentFindings.detail: Distro Qt 6.11.2 sends Qt/QML diagnostics to the systemd journal, not stderr. Without QT_FORCE_STDERR_LOGGING=1 the observed 'zero warnings' on Linux is meaningless.
environmentFindings.note: all warning counts in this evidence were re-measured with QT_FORCE_STDERR_LOGGING=1

environmentFindings.detail: Running the CTest suites of the two build trees concurrently produces failures in varying tests; sequential runs are stable. Not attributed to either Qt version; shared resource not identified.

Before the global environment fix, configuring against distro Qt 6.11.2 failed because the inherited LD_LIBRARY_PATH made the 6.11.2 qmlimportscanner load the 6.8.3 libQt6Core ('version Qt_6.11 not found').
